Class NostrFetchTask<T>

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.pool.fetchpolicy.NostrFetchTask<T>
Type Parameters:
T - fetch result type
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<T>
public final class NostrFetchTask<T> extends Object implements org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<T>
Associates a fetch result with the lifetime of its underlying subscription. Cancelling this task closes the subscription before cancelling the delegated task. Other operations delegate to the result task; tasks returned by then or compose are ordinary chained tasks and do not themselves retain this close action.

    • NostrFetchTask

      public NostrFetchTask(org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<T> task, Runnable close)
      Wraps a result task with the action that retires its subscription. The close action should be idempotent because cancellation may be requested more than once or after normal fetch completion.
      Parameters:
      task - underlying fetch result
      close - action that closes the associated subscription
